name: Hormel Fort Smith Plant - Fort Smith AR

fieldNotes.location: Roster address (4307 Planters Rd) is wrong — Hormel-Planters' Fort Smith plant is at 4020 Planters Rd, Fort Smith AR 72908 (confirmed by Hormel, Fort Smith Chamber, ADEQ permit records; a 'Mr Peanut Sign' landmark sits at 4020). 4307, 4215 (International Paper) and 3807 (Grainger) are separate neighboring addresses on Planters Rd. Resolved to the large multi-building rail-served processing complex at ~35.3035,-94.3813; the roster's geocoded pin landed at the NW employee parking of this complex, so the complex itself is confirmed.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled perimeter gate, barrier arm, or checkpoint pinch-point identified. The Google Street View vehicle drove freely along internal plant roads and dock areas with no gate, and the public-road frontage / employee parking entrances are open. Flagged uncertain because the sprawling complex has several access points. truckGateCount kept at 1 as a nominal value for the primary truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth straddling a truck lane was identified.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A campus of multiple connected processing/warehouse buildings — main processing block plus a long dock warehouse and ancillary structures.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity occurs on physically separate building faces (a west-facing dock bank on the long warehouse and a north-facing dock area), supporting separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs into the property on the east side with rail cars present in imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks across multiple building faces; estimated ~45 total doors (25-50 band) from z18-z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked across the interior yards and dock aprons; estimated ~35 visible (25-50 band).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong / postGateStaging: Deep internal roads and yard space easily hold 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Ample open paved internal yard width.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Fort Smith industrial district on the edge of town, surrounded by woods and other plants — classified Rural per the small-town-industrial rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Estimated ~4 distinct connected buildings; low confidence given the merged complex.
